description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Web and domain checks] Live DNS lookup, like dig or nslookup, for any public host name: one record type or ALL (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA) in one call. Returns each record set, NXDOMAIN (exists: false), per-type errors and private-address flags. Use it to read MX and SPF/verification TXT records or find nameservers. DNS + RDAP + SPF/DMARC + TLS in one call: domain-intel. Cached 2 min. ~0.1-1 s.

host.description: Host name to look up, e.g. example.com or mail.example.com (a URL also works; the host part is used)

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.

type.description: Record type (default ALL = A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA)

name: dns_lookup

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

records.description: One key per record type asked for; [] = no records of that type

title: DNS records lookup (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CAA) ($0.002/call)
